blocks.name: Dam structure (outline from OpenStreetMap way 965129574)
info: OpenStreetMap way 965129574, waterway=dam, about 197 x 85 m

model_basis.assumed: The outline is drawn by OpenStreetMap mappers, not surveyed by the operator. It is raised as one block to the published height, starting at an assumed level 0, because the foundation and river bed elevations are not published. The OpenStreetMap outline shows the spillway piers. The sources give 5 spillway bays of 15 m and 10.5 m gates, and these were not measured against the mapped piers. The gates are not drawn. The powerhouse is part of the block.
